description: Audit-qualified lead list as CSV: takes up to 10 local businesses, checks each Google Business Profile (claimed status, photos, hours, website, description, rating, review count) and returns only those with at least one red flag. Cheaper per business than /gbp-audit when the full batch is used. Costs $0.60 per call via x402.

businesses.description: Array of up to 10 objects, each { business, location }. Location is a city, region and country such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'Austin, Texas, United States'.

name: tariffmonkee-lead-list
